title: Changelog, Roadmap and Status Page Blocks
summary: 16 new blocks for public product communication: changelogs, roadmaps and status pages, with new changelog and roadmap page plans for the MCP server.
body:
Added a set of blocks for telling people what is happening with your product, available under **Blocks** in three new docs pages: Changelog - Releases, Roadmap and Status Page. Every block keeps its own state and takes typed props with fictional sample data.

#### Releases

- A release timeline, version cards with expandable notes, release notes grouped by new, improved and fixed, a changelog with tag filters and search, a compact list and a changelog with an email subscribe card

#### Roadmap

- Quarterly columns, a month timeline with team rows and a hidden table for screen readers, a planned, in progress and shipped board, a voting list, a now, next and later layout and feature request cards with a request dialog

#### Status page

- An uptime overview with 90 day bars, an incident history with update timelines, a component status list with an issues only switch and a subscribe card for email, webhook and RSS

#### MCP

- New `changelog` and `roadmap` page plans, also picked up by `plan-app`
- Block docs links and search keywords cover the new categories
